description: Train: [min_timestamp, val_start_ms). Validation: [val_start_ms, test_start_ms). Test: [test_start_ms, max_timestamp]. Boundaries fixed at the last two 2-week windows of the dataset, computed from the real min/max event timestamps. reranker_label_start_ms further splits the train window in two, entirely within train: sub-train [min_timestamp, reranker_label_start_ms) is used to fit ALS for generating the reranker's own labeled training data, and the label window [reranker_label_start_ms, val_start_ms) is used to generate candidates and label them by actual interaction -- this never touches validation or test.
